hero.title: Software that runs your operation
hero.subtitle: Custom platforms, automations and AI integrations for teams whose operations have outgrown spreadsheets and off-the-shelf tools. | You work directly with the team building your software.

aiIntegration.name: AI Strategy & Integration
aiIntegration.tagline: AI that earns its place in the business.
aiIntegration.description: We start from the business case — where AI actually moves sales, margin or capacity — and ship the integration into the systems your team already uses.
includes: Use-case audit and prioritization by expected return
RAG over your own documents, tickets or catalog
LLM integration into existing flows (CRM, support, back office)
Guardrails, evaluation and cost control per request
deliverables: A working integration running in production
Prompt and retrieval layer documented and versioned
aiIntegration.fit: You have volume of repetitive knowledge work — support, quoting, documentation, classification — and want to measure the impact before scaling it.

businessAutomation.name: Business Automation
businessAutomation.tagline: The manual steps stop being manual.
businessAutomation.description: We map the process as it actually runs today, find the steps that cost hours and errors, and replace them with a workflow that runs on its own — with alerts when something needs a human.
includes: Process mapping and detection of the real bottleneck
Integration between the tools you already pay for
Scheduled jobs, webhooks and event-driven flows
Notifications, retries and error handling
deliverables: Panel to monitor runs and failures
Documentation so your team can operate it
businessAutomation.fit: Your team copies data between systems, chases spreadsheets, or repeats the same sequence of steps every day.

ecommerceSolutions.name: E-commerce & Payments

Monitoring, logs and alerts
scalableArchitecture.fit: Your product works but slows down, falls over under load, or costs more in infrastructure every month.

process.title: How an engagement runs
process.subtitle: Same four steps on every project, whatever the size.

steps.title: Call
steps.description: Thirty minutes to understand the problem. You leave with a first read on scope and feasibility even if we do not work together.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.description: Written scope, phases, timeline and a closed price. No hourly surprises.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Incremental deliveries with a working environment you can review from week one.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.description: Deploy, documentation and a support window. The code and the infrastructure are yours.

items.q: How do you price a project?
items.a: Fixed price per scope, defined after the first call. For open-ended or evolving work, a monthly retainer. You always know the number before anything starts.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: An automation or a landing page: one to three weeks. A full application: six to twelve weeks depending on scope. The proposal breaks it into phases with dates.

items.q: Do you work with existing code?
items.a: Yes. Audits, migrations and feature work on codebases someone else wrote are a regular part of the job.
You do. Repository, infrastructure and accounts are in your name from day one.
A support window is included with every project. After that, maintenance is available as a monthly plan or per request.

items.q: What time zones do you work with?
items.a: Based in Córdoba, Argentina, working with teams in the US, Canada, Europe and Latin America. Overlap with US hours is full, and with Europe it is the morning.

cta.title: Not sure which one you need?
cta.description: Most projects start as one thing and turn out to be another. Describe the problem and we figure out the shape together.
